Context: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

3. Can a Government servant be allowed to enrol with the Bar Association and engage in legal profession?  
A Government servant can be permitted to enrol as an Advocate but should not engage in legal profession as long as in service.  
4. Should a Government servant intimate to the Government regarcling the fixed deposits in a Bank?  
Fixed Deposits in a Bank made by a Government servant out of his salary,or accumulated savings do not come under the purview of Rule 18 (2).
